custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location, with a description, description 1, and Min 1 and Max 5.
  • Have a parts import file with one row for part A: part A's part number, an empty description, Min 2 and Max 6.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; the page is titled Inventory Import Preview).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573680-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573680-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • The inventory import page has Download Template (a file with the right columns), Select CSV File (to pick your file) and Submit File.
custom_steps:
1. Click Select CSV File and pick the file.
  2. Click Submit File.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  7. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes and does not refuse the row.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • Part A is listed with description 1, not empty, and now shows Min 2 and Max 6 (it had 1 and 5): the row was applied without emptying the description.

Step 6:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 7:

  • Part A's entry still shows description 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-N9: “An import row with an empty description never empties a description. An existing Part Library entry keeps its description. A new entry takes its part number as its description.”
  • Story 7, context note: “Context note (S7-N9): before this change, a blank description in an import file emptied an existing entry's description and saved a new entry with none. S7-N9 replaces that.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
